Of 2024) vs In Re: Bijoy Krishna Saha on 12 December, 2024 
 12.12.2024 
 Sl. No.10
 akd
 [Allowed]
 C. R. M. (A) 4316 of 2024
 In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Section  Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed on 03.12.2  connection with Santipur Police Station Case No.197 of 20  12.02.2024 under Sections 420/272/273 of the Indian Penal  with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Ac Section 57 of the Food Safety Standard Act, 2006. (G.R. C  of 2024) 
 And  In Re: Bijoy Krishna Saha  ... ..
 Mr. Susnigdho Bhattacharyya  ... ... for the petitione  Mr. Tirupati Mukherjee  ... ... for the Stat  1.
Heard learned Advocates for both the parties.
2 . We have considered the materials on record. We have also examined the chemical examiner's report. Report does not show the seized food items are harmful for human consumption. In view of the aforesaid fact, we are of the opinion custodial interrogation of the accused/petitioner for progress of investigation is not necessary and he may be granted anticipatory bail. 
3. Accordingly, we direct in the event of arrest, the accused/petitioner, namely, Bijoy Krishna Saha,
be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and on further condition that the petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date. Signed By : ARUP KUMAR DAS High Court of Calcutta 13 th of December 2024 04:32:16 PM 4. The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, disposed of. (Apurba Sinha Ray, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
